committee: Cardiovascular and Renal Drugs Advisory Committee
indication: Anemia of chronic kidney disease in adult dialysis patients
notes: CRDAC voted 13-3 benefits outweigh risks for daprodustat in dialysis patients. A separate question on non-dialysis patients voted 5-11 against (rejected as dedup collision, see reject ledger). FDA approved Feb 2023 as Jesduvroq for dialysis patients only. Verified from GSK press release; corroborated by Medthority, Healio, PharmacyTimes.

indication: Previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) in combination with R-CHP
notes: ODAC voted 11-2 in favor of clinical benefit of Polivy+R-CHP for untreated DLBCL. First treatment in 20 years to show significant PFS improvement. sBLA approved Apr 19, 2023. Verified from Genentech press release.

indication: Mild-to-moderate COVID-19 in adult patients at high risk for progression to severe illness
notes: AMDAC voted 16-1 that data support safety and effectiveness of Paxlovid. PDUFA action date May 2023; FDA approved May 25, 2023. Verified from Pfizer press release.
